facts.text: Deborah mentioned a cool hidden coffee shop near her that she remembered seeing in a photo.

evidence.quote: That pic looks so peaceful. Reminded me of a cool hidden coffee shop near me.
Sounds good, Jolene! When did you have in mind? That cafe rocks.

facts.text: Jolene suggested meeting at the coffee shop on Wednesday at 4.

evidence.quote: How about Wednesday at 4? Can't wait to catch up over coffee!

facts.text: Deborah had plans for the day and could not meet on Wednesday.

evidence.quote: Sorry, I remembered that I already have plans for this day.

facts.text: Jolene adjusted her plans to Friday at 5, mentioning she needed to sort out books from a bookcase.

evidence.quote: How about Friday at 5? I will need to sort out the books from this bookcase and I will be free.
